needs.what: an exploit keyword (702.110): an enters trigger 'you may sacrifice a creature' that the engine marks as an exploit, so the sacrifice can be recognised as 'exploiting', and that a grant_keyword static can hand to other creatures ("Other legendary creatures you control have exploit")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: exploit is not in `keywords`, so the grant_keyword static cannot name it; a hand-written self_enters trigger with may + sacrifice reproduces the sacrifice but not the keyword identity that other cards (and this card's third line) key on, and a grant_ability static of that trigger would not count as 'having exploit'

needs.what: a trigger event 'a creature you control exploits a creature' -- fires when a creature's exploit trigger resolves with a sacrifice, binding the exploiting creature (filtered by controller) and the sacrificed creature
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the `sacrificed` event fires on any sacrifice (costs, edicts, other effects) and nothing in `trigger_keys` or `trigger_filter_keys` restricts it to sacrifices made by an exploit ability, so it would overtrigger
